name.description: Folder name and catalog key; the store namespace is a.<name>. 1-13 characters from a-z, 0-9, '-', '_'.

author.description: Application author, required for new applications and publication. Up to 63 UTF-8 bytes, without ASCII control characters or leading/trailing spaces. Perinkpheral is reserved for official applications.

abi.description: Perinkpheral OS API version the application is built for.

format.description: Default response format for scheduled polls and requests from code. An explicit format ignores Content-Type. When omitted, Content-Type selects JSON or XML, with other responses delivered as raw bytes.

firmware.description: Minimum firmware version, computed from the ABI floor, imported calls, exported handlers, recognized manifest features and any higher explicit minimum.

fullscreen.description: true: 400x300 without the Perinkpheral OS header. false: 400x260 under the header.

system.description: Request for the system API (sys_* calls).

polls.description: Requests Perinkpheral OS repeats. The application receives each by its index.

url.description: http(s) address. {{key}} is replaced by the stored setting. A url setting may supply the server prefix. A link setting must supply the entire URL.

every.description: Seconds, 10 to 86400, or "{{key}}" of a setting that holds the interval ("15 min", "1 h").

format.description: Response format for this poll. Overrides the application default and ignores the response Content-Type.

pick.description: JSON paths Perinkpheral OS extracts, delivered through app_on_picked(). "[*]" once in a path: every element of an array, read with answer_count() and answer_element().

each.description: Key of a list setting: one request for every item, {{key}} being the item; answer_item() says which.

prefix.description: With each: the poll takes only the items that begin with it, {{key}} being the item without it. A poll of the list without a prefix takes the items no other poll claims: one list, several sources (AAPL, MOEX:SBER).

hosts.description: Hosts http_send() may address. "{{key}}" names a url or link setting.

settings.description: Fields of the settings form on the device page. Values are read with kv_get() by key.

default.description: What the setting reads as while nothing is stored. A list's is a list of items.

certificates.description: Certificate authorities trusted for this application's own requests, beside the browsers' set: files of its files/ folder, each a root in PEM or DER, up to 4 KB. The web page names them before installation.
